source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-unmappable-entity-type-would-unscope-the-read.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: entity-ids-transformer can only turn a known entity_type into a narrowing *_ids filter, and crm_inventory_stock_balance_list documents 'ALL FILTERS OPTIONAL — call with none to span every product'. An unmappable type therefore contributes NO narrowing and would trigger a full-table prod read that labels every candidate 'has stock'. It must be dropped.
